accepted.s: Which of the following is the principal goal of the Andhra Pradesh Export Promotion Policy (APEX) 2022–27?
o: To replace all private ports with government ports
To make Andhra Pradesh a leading export hub
To restrict exports to agricultural commodities
To establish only inland trade corridors
accepted.x: APEX 2022–27 seeks to make Andhra Pradesh a leading export hub.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the stated policy goal.
accepted.sec: AP trade and retail policies - objectives and employment targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT an objective associated with the Andhra Pradesh Export Promotion Policy (APEX) 2022–27?
o: Integrated export ecosystems from districts to ports
accepted.x: APEX 2022–27 promotes global market access, logistics, competitiveness, institutions and district-to-port ecosystems; exclusive dependence on domestic markets is not its objective.
accepted.tq: Find the option that reverses the policy’s export-oriented objective.
accepted.sec: AP trade and retail policies - objectives and employment targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following targets of the Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024–29):
1. Investment of Rs 30 lakh crore
2. FDI of US$ 10 billion
3. Creation of 5 lakh jobs
4. Exports of US$ 40 billion
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The policy targets Rs 30 lakh crore investment, US$ 10 billion FDI, 5 lakh jobs and US$ 40 billion exports. It also targets more than 175 industrial parks.
accepted.tq: Statement-combination question testing multiple numerical targets.
accepted.sec: AP trade and retail policies - objectives and employment targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024–29) targets the establishment of at least how many industrial parks?
accepted.x: Industrial Development Policy 4.0 targets 175 or more industrial parks.
accepted.tq: Direct numerical recall using nearby policy figures as distractors.
accepted.sec: AP trade and retail policies - objectives and employment targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which organisation is building the Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster under the Andhra Pradesh Maritime Policy?
accepted.x: The special purpose vehicle NSHIP-AP Ltd is building the Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster.
accepted.tq: Who-is-associated-with-which-project recall.
accepted.sec: AP trade and retail policies - objectives and employment targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster aims to achieve what share of national shipbuilding capacity by 2047?
accepted.x: The cluster aims to secure a 25% share of national shipbuilding capacity by 2047.
accepted.tq: Direct percentage recall with ascending numerical options.
accepted.sec: AP trade and retail policies - objectives and employment targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the cargo handled by the specified non-major ports up to November 2025?
o: Krishnapatnam—41.09 MMT; Gangavaram—24.39 MMT; Kakinada Deep Water—12.93 MMT
Krishnapatnam—24.39 MMT; Gangavaram—41.09 MMT; Kakinada Deep Water—12.93 MMT
Krishnapatnam—12.93 MMT; Gangavaram—24.39 MMT; Kakinada Deep Water—41.09 MMT
Krishnapatnam—41.09 MMT; Gangavaram—12.93 MMT; Kakinada Deep Water—24.39 MMT
accepted.x: The recorded cargo figures are 41.09 MMT for Krishnapatnam, 24.39 MMT for Gangavaram and 12.93 MMT for Kakinada Deep Water.
accepted.tq: Match each port with its cargo figure rather than relying on the largest-port clue alone.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: Which one of the following commodities is NOT specifically identified as being handled by Visakhapatnam Port?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Port handles seafood, iron ore and crude oil. Coir products are associated with the East Godavari District Export Hub.
accepted.tq: Odd commodity identification using a nearby export-product distractor.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: Visakhapatnam Port was ranked first among India’s seafood-export ports after handling approximately what quantity in 2025–26?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Port handled 5.12 lakh tonnes of seafood and remained India’s top seafood-export port.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of quantity linked with a ranking claim.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding cargo movement in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Coal and general cargo are handled at the new berths of Machilipatnam, Mulapeta and Kakinada SEZ.
2. Crude oil at Rawa is moved by SBM to Chennai, Visakhapatnam and Haldia.
3. Crude oil at Rawa is transported only by road to inland markets.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Coal and general cargo are handled at the specified new berths, while Rawa crude oil is moved by SBM to Chennai, Visakhapatnam and Haldia. The claim that it is transported only by road is false.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme word ‘only’ and identify the correct cargo routes.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the port structure and coastline of Andhra Pradesh?
o: 1 major port and  seven notified non-major ports; coastline of 853.07 km
2 major ports and 17 notified non-major ports; coastline of 1,053.07 km
17 major ports and 1 notified non-major port; coastline of 1,053.70 km
1 major port and 17 notified non-major ports; coastline of 1,053.07 km
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has one major port, Visakhapatnam, and 17 notified non-major ports, including three captive ports; its coastline is 1,053.07 km.
accepted.tq: Compare port categories and coastline figures without reversing major and non-major status.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Krishnapatnam operates under the PPP BOST model initiated in 2004. Gangavaram uses the BOOT model, Kakinada Anchorage is associated with APMB, and Rawa with Cairn India SBM.
accepted.tq: Start from the port–operating-model pair and eliminate swapped models.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with its capacity or operating detail?
accepted.x: Krishnapatnam has a capacity of 98 MMTPA. Gangavaram has 64 MMTPA, Kakinada Deep Water 26 MMTPA and Kakinada Anchorage 4 MMTPA.
accepted.tq: Match capacity figures to ports using the distinct numerical values.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding greenfield ports in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: Ramayapatnam was the least advanced project at 34.04% progress.
Machilipatnam has a planned capacity of 35 MTPA and progress of 48.35%.
Kakinada Gateway has a planned capacity of 35 MTPA.
Mulapeta has a planned capacity of 16 MTPA.
accepted.x: Machilipatnam has a planned capacity of 35 MTPA and was 48.35% complete as of October 2025. Ramayapatnam was the most advanced at 74.34%, Mulapeta is 23.5 MTPA and Kakinada Gateway is 16 MTPA.
accepted.tq: Use the correct port–capacity–progress combination to reject swapped figures.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: The four greenfield ports of Ramayapatnam, Mulapeta, Machilipatnam and Kakinada Gateway are together expected to add approximately how much capacity by 2030?
accepted.x: Together, the greenfield ports are expected to add about 145 MTPA by 2030, involving approximately Rs 16,000 crore of investment.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the combined capacity target.
accepted.sec: Port-based trade - cargo handled by AP ports, commodity composition

accepted.s: Which District Export Hub is correctly matched with its products?
o: Visakhapatnam—marine products, engineering goods and health services
East Godavari—chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn
Guntur—coir products, cashew and nursery plants
Visakhapatnam—coir products, cashew and nursery plants
accepted.x: The Phase-I Visakhapatnam District Export Hub covers marine products, engineering goods and health services. East Godavari covers coir, cashew and nursery plants, while Guntur covers chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure district–product association and eliminate shifted product groups.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which district is associated with chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn under the Phase-I District Export Hubs?
accepted.x: Guntur’s District Export Hub covers chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn.
accepted.tq: Direct district–product recall.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which organisation is the nodal agency for the District Export Hubs initiative?
accepted.x: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade is the nodal agency leading the District Export Hubs initiative.
accepted.tq: Who-would-do-this-job identification of the nodal agency.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding District Export Hubs:
1. The initiative was launched in 2019 under the Foreign Trade Policy.
2. State and District Export Promotion Committees prepare District Export Action Plans.
3. It covers 590 districts, of which 249 have been notified.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The District Export Hubs initiative began in 2019 under the Foreign Trade Policy, with action plans prepared by State and District Export Promotion Committees.
accepted.tq: Combine launch year, institutional mechanism and coverage figures.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between One District One Product (ODOP) and District Export Hubs?
o: ODOP was discontinued and replaced by the Export Preparedness Index.
District Export Hubs were merged into ODOP and lost their DGFT linkage.
ODOP was operationally merged into District Export Hubs.
ODOP and District Export Hubs remained entirely unrelated programmes.
accepted.x: ODOP was operationally merged into District Export Hubs. The phased rollout also provides Dak Ghar Niryat Kendras for small postal exports and no separate fund.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between merger, replacement and independent operation of related programmes.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Dak Ghar Niryat Kendras are intended primarily to handle which activity under the District Export Hubs rollout?
o: Allocation of FDI to industrial parks
accepted.x: Dak Ghar Niryat Kendras facilitate small postal exports under the phased District Export Hubs rollout.
accepted.tq: Apply the institutional name to its stated function.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In the Export Preparedness Index 2024, Andhra Pradesh ranked how high among large States?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked fifth among large States in EPI 2024, improving from eighth in EPI 2022.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current rank from earlier EPI ranks.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh ranked ninth in which edition of the Export Preparedness Index?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked ninth in EPI 2021, the second edition of the index. It ranked fifth in EPI 2024 and had ranked eighth in EPI 2022 according to the stated comparison.
accepted.tq: Separate closely placed index years and ranks.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly gives the first two leading large States in EPI 2024?
accepted.x: Maharashtra ranked first and Tamil Nadu second among the leading large States in EPI 2024.
accepted.tq: Direct ranking recall with reversed-order distractors.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four pillars of the Export Preparedness Index?
accepted.x: The four pillars are export policy, business environment, export infrastructure and export performance.
accepted.tq: Identify the outsider from a named framework.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the weights of the EPI 2024 pillars:
1. Business Ecosystem carries 40% weight.
2. Export Infrastructure carries 20% weight.
3. Policy and Governance carries 20% weight.
4. Export Performance carries 20% weight.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Business Ecosystem has a 40% weight, while Export Infrastructure, Policy and Governance, and Export Performance each carry 20%.
accepted.tq: Test the full distribution of weights rather than only the highest value.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the structure of the Export Preparedness Index?
o: It has 70 sub-pillars and 13 indicators, with three categories of States.
It has 13 indicators and 70 categories, with no classification of States.
It has 4 sub-pillars and 13 indicators, with only one category of States.
It has 13 sub-pillars and 70 indicators, with two categories of States and Union Territories.
accepted.x: The index has 13 sub-pillars and 70 indicators. It covers two categories—Large States and Small/NE States and UTs—and grades them as Leaders, Challengers or Aspirers.
accepted.tq: Match the framework’s counts and classification structure.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Export Preparedness Index was first introduced in which year?
accepted.x: The first edition of the Export Preparedness Index was prepared in 2020.
accepted.tq: Chronological recall of the index’s first edition.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Export Preparedness Index is prepared in association with which institution?
accepted.x: The Export Preparedness Index is prepared in association with the Institute for Competitiveness.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional partner rather than the implementing agency of another programme.
accepted.sec: Export promotion - District Export Hubs, ODOP, Export Preparedness Index rank  [APPSC]
